name: Interaction Overview Diagram
description: Interaction Overview Diagram describes the high-level coordination flow between multiple interactions or sub-sequence diagrams. It combines Activity Diagram thinking with interaction occurrences.
purpose: Coordinate multiple sub-sequence diagrams, acting as a high-level map for many detailed interactions.
bestFor: Manage large flows consisting of multiple sub-features that each have their own Sequence diagram
Describe an overall journey: login → select items → payment → delivery
Coordinate multiple interactions with branches, fork/join, or decisions
Act as a high-level map for many detailed sequence diagrams
notSuitableFor: Only have a single simple interaction flow → use Sequence Diagram
Need to describe detailed workflow for each action → use Activity Diagram
Need to describe high-level functionality → use Use Case Diagram
useCases: Add fork/join to coordinate parallel interactions

confusableWith.difference: Sequence describes a single interaction in detail; Interaction Overview coordinates multiple sub-interactions.
Activity uses regular actions; Interaction Overview uses interaction occurrences as main nodes.
